card.name: Inside split medical words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a longer word that has been split up, often a medical term or an all-caps warning heading. The marked piece is followed by more of the same word.

modes.label: Suicide warning heading
modes.description: The middle piece ID inside SUICIDALITY or SUICIDAL in all-caps boxed warnings.

modes.label: Other split clinical words
modes.description: Middle pieces of words like pneumonitis, susceptible, extravasation or suction.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long medical words that get broken into pieces, especially the word suicidality in warning headings.
